$comment: Regulated is Balanced with stricter gate rows, one setting, a tier 2 go-live group and stricter separation rules (document 21, sections 6.2, 6.3 and 7.6). The changes are in patch.json.

Proposal, not in document 21: conflictsWith lists small-team. Regulated refuses self-approval at every tier and small team allows it with an exception (document 28, Q10), so the two give opposite answers. The build also needs it: Regulated retires no-self-approval-tier-3, and the small team overlay would give that retired key new content (V04). Document 21 declares only small team against strict separation. The product owner can drop this line; the small team overlay then needs another way to land on Regulated.
